# ARK-OS nginx regression fixture

`ark-ui.nginx` is `frontend/ark-ui.nginx` from ARK-OS commit
`423570c1021174ca15801c5182ec288862865ad4`, shipped by the pinned 1.2.0 Noble
package. Its SHA-256 is checked directly by the helper tests. `LICENSE` retains
ARK Electronics' MIT license. The fixture has no device or customer information.
